tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every section sits on it. Light 15.8:1 under ink, dark 14.6:1.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised ground: the open body of an In depth disclosure, the email field. Ink 16.6:1 light, 13.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed ground: the degree band behind the timeline, code. Ink 14.2:1 light, 15.4:1 dark; ink-muted 6.0:1 light, 8.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All running text, headings and timeline titles, on paper, surface, sunken and accent-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, field labels, captions, lane headers. 6.6:1 on paper light, 7.7:1 dark; never below 6.0:1 on any ground.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only, 1.4:1. Never the only thing that separates two things a reader must tell apart.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Lines that carry meaning: the timeline spine, month ticks, entry bars, the disclosure's border. 3.6:1 or more on every ground, both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links (always underlined too), the focus ring, the disclosure marker. 5.5:1 or more on every ground. One hue only, kept off LinkedIn's blue.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover and pressed state. 8.9:1 light, 12.3:1 dark on paper.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Hover wash behind a disclosure summary or a link target. Ink 14.0:1 light, 11.1:1 dark; accent 5.4:1 light, 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a solid accent fill, such as the copy button when pressed. 6.3:1 light, 9.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset. 5.5:1 or more on every ground.

tokens.name: mark-ink
tokens.usage: Ink for the GitHub mark: pure black in light, pure white in dark, the two forms GitHub publishes. Not for text.

families.prose: "Source Serif 4", "Source Serif 4 fallback times", "Source Serif 4 fallback noto", Georgia, serif
families.prose-alt: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Next fallback arial", "Atkinson Next fallback roboto", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", "Plex Mono fallback courier", ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The name in the Intro, once per page. 34px at 360px wide.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings: Projects, Timeline, Work, Education, Certifications, Skills, Contact.

styles.name: fact
styles.usage: Layer 1, the checkable fact under each entry title.
styles.sample: A 24-node LangGraph pipeline at 3.7-second first-response latency

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, layer 2 summaries and layer 3 points. 17px/28px at 360px wide. Measure 66ch at most.
styles.sample: Primary architect and director. The hard part is reasoning truthfully about eligibility.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Timeline titles, certification titles, skill items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Figure captions and stack lines, set in italic.

styles.name: body-b
styles.sample: Primary architect and director. The hard part is reasoning truthfully about eligibility.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels and lane headers: DATES, STACK, PROOF, BUILDS. Letter-spacing 0.08em.

styles.name: date
styles.usage: Dates beside titles, timeline dates, credential domains.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Email address, URLs shown as text, credential IDs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline items, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its date line.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter at 360px; gap between paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside an entry; side gutter from 720px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between entries.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its first entry at desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections at 360px.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Gap between sections at desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Entries, sections, the timeline: no rounding.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Focus ring, the copy button, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: The open body of an In depth disclosure.

timeline.note: Timeline geometry. One layout unit per row, four rows per month, from January 2024 (ADR-0003).

tokens.name: tl-unit
tokens.usage: Height of one layout unit. A month is 28px.

tokens.name: tl-spine
tokens.usage: Width of the spine column that carries month ticks and year labels.

tokens.name: tl-break
tokens.usage: Below this width the timeline becomes a one-sided chronological list, not to scale.

tokens.name: measure-prose
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text.

tokens.name: measure-page
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page content, timeline included.
